resources.string: Your SSH username is still required. Import the private key; install its public (.pub) key on the computer. The imported key and passphrase are encrypted on this phone and excluded from JSON backups.
Import a private key first. Keys must be re-imported after restoring a backup.
Cannot read this key. Select an OpenSSH or PEM private key file (not .pub), up to 64 KB.
Required for private key authentication. Copy the SHA256 fingerprint from ssh-keygen -lf on the computer’s SSH host public key. A changed fingerprint blocks the connection.
Enter the server fingerprint: SHA256: followed by its Base64 digest.
Could not save the device securely. Your SSH key was not saved.
